original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: For old call B and frozen frames A, P, and Q, prove that every rational rank-one splitting of 2I fails the extended P-coefficient and AB-coefficient counts, including the displayed t=2 frames, and that a lattice word using all six labels has at least ten calls.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a larger or nonabelian native alphabet. This package stays in the abelian symmetric 2-by-2 model and answers the rational-splitting question left open by PR #7067, whose integral pairs already fail the P-coefficient test.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the signed-frame escape. The length-6 splitting is not a word and cannot sit inside a lattice word shorter than ten calls, so there is no local call-count saving and no selected-frontier change.
stop_rule: Stop after the character count for every rational splitting of 2I on this six-label multiset, the t=2 residue census, and the lattice ten-call corollary. Do not replay the #7067 support census or move to six new labels or four-plus-two old projectors.
evidence: Proof: the odd multiplier m makes m c and m(a+b) characters detecting two calls and four targets for every primitive direction, and no rank-one lattice matrix has character (1,1). Exhaustive residue census at t=2: 25 integral classes in each family, all even on both frames. Finite control on the 1440 primitive vectors in [-24,24]^2. The inherited inequality is not reproved.

ai_assistance: Substantial Cursor Grok assistance with the proof and verifier. No independent human or formal-kernel review.

open_questions.question: Is there a rank-one matrix Y outside the t=2 lattice for which every AB lift and every P-coefficient lift integral on the displayed frames detects Y?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Length 6 and length 7 cannot contain all six labels. Inside the lattice the bound is ten calls. A cancelling pair Y, -Y outside the lattice is the shortest remaining shape that could still meet both inequalities, and meeting them would still not make it a word.
open_questions.first_step: Repeat the t=2 lift census on Y=(0,0,1/3). The half projector P/2 is already a negative example: the lift a+3b misses it.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package stops once P/2 is recorded. No other outside matrix is tested.
